name: Procter & Gamble
description: P&G makes household brands sold mainly through retailers (Walmart and affiliates are about 16% of sales; the top ten customers 43%): Tide and Dawn in laundry and home care, Pampers, Always and Charmin in baby, feminine and family care, Olay and Pantene in beauty, Crest and Oral-B in health care, and Gillette in grooming. Profit comes from repeat purchases at premium prices, with about 23% pretax margin across segments. FY2026 net sales were $87.0B (+3%, but organic only +1%, all from price) and net earnings $16.1B. It returned over $15B to shareholders in FY2026 ($10.2B dividends, $5.0B buybacks) and has an ongoing restructuring, cutting employees 4%.

businessLines.name: Fabric & Home Care
businessLines.how: Laundry and home-care products (Tide, Ariel, Downy, Dawn, Febreze) sold through retailers; repeat purchase, premium pricing on performance.

businessLines.name: Baby, Feminine & Family Care
businessLines.how: Diapers (Pampers), feminine care (Always, Tampax) and family care (Bounty, Charmin) sold through retailers.

businessLines.name: Beauty
businessLines.how: Hair care, skin and personal care (Olay, Head & Shoulders, Pantene, SK-II) sold through retailers and online.

businessLines.name: Health Care
businessLines.how: Oral care (Crest, Oral-B) and personal health care (Vicks, Metamucil) sold through retailers.

businessLines.name: Grooming
businessLines.how: Razors and blades (Gillette, Venus) and appliances (Braun) - razor plus recurring blade model.
